description: AIW knowledge constitution. Enforced by packages/engine (knowledgeGovernance, claimAssembly) and scripts/verify-knowledge.mjs as a release-blocking gate.
countingPredicate: A 'reviewed record' for any production gate is one where: status in reviewedStatuses AND required fields complete AND >=1 approved-posture evidence AND named owner AND reviewedAt date. Status strings alone never satisfy a gate.

corroboration.ratingBearingAssertions: Claims that set or alter quality ratings, prohibitions or hard applicability boundaries require >=2 independent approved-posture sources OR one internal expert ratification (accountable, dated, supersedable).

contradictionPolicy: Same subject+predicate with opposite polarity and no distinguishing conditions is a contradiction. Resolution is a CONTEXT SPLIT (conditions attached to each claim); silent winners are prohibited. Unresolved contradictions block promotion of the affected records only.

sourceSchema.dimensions: sourceClass defines permitted uses; trustTier scales evidence weight. They are independent.
sourceSchema.popularityRule: Stars/forks/popularity may appear only in discovery triage. They never enter governance surfaces, evidence weight, or recommendation scores.

rules.note: fact-discovery only; no content or code enters approved records

licencePolicy.finalAuthority: legal counsel, not the ingestion engine

releasePins.rule: A knowledge release is reproducible only if library hash, claims hash and embedding-model version are pinned in data/knowledge-release-manifest.json and verified by the gate.

kernelInvariants: No network I/O inside the intelligence kernel; production recommendations answer from the governed release.
Source renames, corroboration changes or retrieval reordering must never alter recommendation semantics (tested in constitution.invariants.test.ts).
Discovery-posture evidence may corroborate, never solely justify (blocker DISCOVERY_ONLY_EVIDENCE).
